questions.q: Arrange the events of Mohan Singh Oberoi's life in chronological order.
orderItems: He works as a hotel desk clerk in Shimla, earning ₹50 a month
He mortgages his wife's jewellery to buy a small hotel
questions.explanation: Oberoi was born in Punjab in 1898, worked as a desk clerk in Shimla, bought his first hotel in 1934 by mortgaging his wife's jewellery, received the Padma Bhushan in 2001, and passed away in 2002.
questions.fact: Born in Punjab in 1898... desk clerk earning ₹50 a month... In 1934... mortgaging his wife's jewellery... Padma Bhushan in 2001... He passed away in 2002.

questions.q: Arrange the events of the Dandekar brothers' business journey in the correct order.

They sell liquid ink in recycled glass bottles
They notice that artists lack good art materials
They travel to Glasgow to study colour chemistry
They set up a laboratory and expand into pencils, crayons and paints
questions.explanation: The brothers began with ink powder in 1931, used recycled glass bottles for liquid ink, spotted the gap in art materials, studied colour chemistry in Glasgow, and then set up a laboratory and expanded their product range.
questions.fact: Started selling ink powder in South Mumbai... recycled glass bottles to sell liquid ink... artists did not have access to good art materials... travelled to Glasgow to study colour chemistry... set up a laboratory... expanded into pencils, crayons, geometry boxes, and paints.
